plan.name: Keep proof and declared assumptions independent
plan.summary: Add supplied, explicitly assumed and unverified component records alongside proof evidence, and optional actual proof invocation, file-input and tool-pin provenance while preserving existing proof fields, valid proof-only callers and extra known references. Make proof and assumption attribution independent atomic replacements, including clears: validate a detached inventory and every retained kind against canonical declarations, selections and snapshots, reject stale or invalid batches without changing report bytes or fingerprints, and preserve exact-target proof coverage, gate outcomes, legacy checks and ratified data. Own all nested inputs and canonically fingerprint declarations, assumptions and optional proof provenance after attribution and JSON decoding, preserving set-order and relocation stability, argument order and existing volatile exclusions, with no execution, discovery, instrumentation or gate connection. Update SPEC.md and README.md, citing supporting decisions on changed SPEC bullets, to describe the APIs, JSON, compatibility, replacement rules and execution limits; correct Report documentation and only the explicit receipt footer to allow supplied data and declared assumptions, update its existing delimiter assertion, preserve legacy Markdown and escaping, and state that Markdown still shows proof coverage while new evidence details remain in JSON. The merger must record the new attribution, independent replacement and trusted-assumption policy because those decisions are not yet recorded and this plumbing build cannot write decisions/; preserve pinned statements and ratified locks and retain all existing proof, provenance and legacy compatibility tests.

tests.name: TestIndependentComponentEvidenceCoexistsWithoutTransferringProof
tests.says: Supplied assumed/unverified records coexist with exact-target proof, never prove neighbors or helpers, never materialize from declarations, and preserve valid old proof calls with extra known references and incomplete or failed attempts.

tests.name: TestIndependentComponentEvidenceReplacesAndClearsOnlyItsKind
tests.says: Both attribution orders and both clear orders replace only their own kind, preserve gate pass/fail and all legacy and ratified data, and finalize canonical fingerprints.

tests.name: TestComponentProofActualProvenanceIsOptionalAndRetained
tests.says: Optional actual proof invocation, file snapshots and tool identity/pins are retained separately from declaration Inputs, validated against selected declarations and complete input provenance, without being required or synthesized for old proof callers.

tests.name: TestComponentEvidenceRejectsInvalidRecordsAtomically
tests.says: Unknown, duplicate, bare-name, unselected, stale and late-batch proof or assumption records and mismatched actual provenance fail without changing serialized report bytes or stored/recomputed fingerprints.

tests.name: TestComponentEvidenceRejectsInvalidReplacementInventories
tests.says: Both operations validate replacement inventories even on clears, using production targets and separate check/file provenance, allowing matching overlaps and target-local identities while rejecting duplicate, unknown or inconsistent references and snapshots.

tests.name: TestComponentEvidenceRevalidatesRetainedKindsOnReplaceAndClear
tests.says: Assumption replacement or clearing rejects retained stale proof targets, contracts, inputs, invocation metadata and coverage changes, including incomplete attempts; proof replacement or clearing rejects retained changed, removed or stale assumptions.

tests.name: TestComponentEvidenceFingerprintBindsEveryNewSemanticInput
tests.says: After JSON decoding, fingerprints bind assumption presence, target, snapshots, statement, reason and source, actual invocation identity and metadata, file snapshots and tool identity/pins; valid changed inputs also change attributed fingerprints.

tests.name: TestComponentEvidenceCanonicalOrderAndRelocation
tests.says: Reordered inventories, record/completion sets and decoded reports and relocated checkouts retain canonical evidence and fingerprints, while argument order remains meaningful and legacy volatile exclusions survive.

tests.name: TestComponentEvidenceOwnsEveryNestedInput
tests.says: Mutating caller inventories, assumption records and proof declaration/file inputs, invocation arguments/maps/files and tool pins cannot change stored report JSON or fingerprints in either attribution order.

tests.name: TestComponentEvidenceAttributionNeverExecutes
tests.says: Sentinel commands confirm supplied attribution runs no tools, explicit Check and Run still return ErrComponents before execution, model-only checking remains available, and model-only reports reject either attribution atomically.

tests.name: TestComponentReceiptAcknowledgesSuppliedData
tests.says: Explicit receipts acknowledge recorded checks, supplied data and declared assumptions while retaining proof coverage, hostile-literal escaping, report bytes and fingerprints; legacy receipt footers and rendering remain unchanged.
